Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the BTC/USD spot price reaches or exceeds $100,000 USD at any point during the 24-hour period of 2026-07-22 (00:00:00 UTC to 23:59:59 UTC), as reported by Coinbase.
- "No": Wins if the BTC/USD spot price does not reach $100,000 USD at any point during the 24-hour period of 2026-07-22 (00:00:00 UTC to 23:59:59 UTC), as reported by Coinbase.

Clarifications:
- "Reaches $100,000" means the BTC/USD spot price trades at or above $100,000.00 USD for at least one moment within the specified 24-hour window.
